analysis.headline: Shares Your Data Widely
analysis.quote: We may disclose Information to business partners and third parties (e.g., other companies, retailers, distributors, social media networks, research organizations, publishers, and non-profit organizations) for their own purposes, including marketing products or services to you, showing you relevant advertising, or providing an enhanced experience that integrates with one of our Services.

analysis.headline: Shares with Affiliates for Marketing
analysis.quote: Also, where we are permitted to do so under applicable law, we may disclose Information to other Controllers in our family of companies so that they can contact you about other Services we provide.

analysis.headline: Records Your Interactions
analysis.quote: Usage and Viewing Information: ...including recordings of your interactions with our Services, which may include mouse clicks, mouse movements, keystrokes, and page scrolling. When you use our Service, you consent to the recording of your interactions with us.

analysis.headline: Collects Sensitive Health, Race Info
analysis.quote: Demographic Information: In limited cases, physical or mental health, race, or ethnicity, religious or philosophical beliefs, sex life, sexual orientation, or political affiliation.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Biometric Data
analysis.quote: We may also collect data that could be considered biometric if you choose to participate in one of our interactive research studies or other initiatives that involve the collection of this data.

analysis.headline: Third Parties Track You
analysis.quote: WBD (including our affiliates) and third parties may use these technologies to collect information over time from apps, websites, and other digital products. We and third-party advertising companies may use this Information to help serve advertising tailored to your interests, both on and off the WBD Services.

analysis.headline: Your Data Transfers Globally
analysis.quote: Sometimes our use of your Information requires your Information to be transferred to countries outside the country where you are located, including countries where the level of legal protection for your Information may be different.

analysis.headline: Deletion Rights Are Limited
analysis.quote: In specific cases, we may not be able to delete some types of Information, in particular, where we have a legal obligation to keep that Information (e.g., for regulatory reporting purposes), or where you want us to continue to provide you with a Service and the processing of the Information is necessary for the provision of that Service.

analysis.headline: No Perfect Security Guaranteed
analysis.quote: Unfortunately, no security measures are perfect, and we cannot assure you that Information will never be accessed or used in an unauthorized way.
